# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.5 Worker 3: Condottieri Contracts, Free Company Mutiny Disaster & Gunpowder Logistics Reform (oe_mer2_, 0 slots, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v125_mercenaries.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Safely initialize, increment/decrement, and clamp oe_mer2_arrears_risk in [0, 100].
oe_mer2_add_arrears_risk = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_mer2_arrears_risk } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_mer2_arrears_risk value = 0 }
	}
	change_variable = {
		name = oe_mer2_arrears_risk
		add = $AMOUNT$
	}
	clamp_variable = {
		name = oe_mer2_arrears_risk
		min = 0
		max = 100
	}
}

# Country scope. Clear any previously active regional condottieri charter before applying a new one or reforming.
oe_mer2_clear_regional_charters = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_mer2_charter_condottieri }
		remove_country_modifier = oe_mer2_charter_condottieri
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_mer2_charter_swiss }
		remove_country_modifier = oe_mer2_charter_swiss
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_mer2_charter_landsknechte }
		remove_country_modifier = oe_mer2_charter_landsknechte
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_mer2_charter_stradioti }
		remove_country_modifier = oe_mer2_charter_stradioti
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_mer2_charter_kriegsunternehmer }
		remove_country_modifier = oe_mer2_charter_kriegsunternehmer
	}
}

# Country scope. Match 5 historical mercenary company flavors from $PATRON$'s capital region.
oe_mer2_apply_regional_charter = {
	oe_mer2_clear_regional_charters = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			$PATRON$ = {
				exists = capital
				capital.region = region:italy_region
			}
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_mer2_charter_condottieri
			years = 5
			mode = replace
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			$PATRON$ = {
				exists = capital
				OR = {
					capital.region = region:south_german_region
					capital.region = region:france_region
				}
			}
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_mer2_charter_swiss
			years = 5
			mode = replace
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { current_age_or_later = { age = age_5_absolutism } }
			$PATRON$ = {
				exists = capital
				OR = {
					capital.region = region:north_german_region
					capital.region = region:carpathia_region
				}
			}
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_mer2_charter_landsknechte
			years = 5
			mode = replace
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			$PATRON$ = {
				exists = capital
				OR = {
					capital.region = region:balkan_region
					capital.region = region:ruthenia_region
					capital.region = region:steppes_region
					capital.region = region:anatolia_region
				}
			}
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_mer2_charter_stradioti
			years = 5
			mode = replace
		}
	}
	else = {
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_mer2_charter_kriegsunternehmer
			years = 5
			mode = replace
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Inject a temporary special_demands entry into the capital market if present.
oe_mer2_inject_capital_demand = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = capital }
		capital = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = market }
				market = {
					add_temporary_demand = {
						type = demand:$DEMAND$
						years = $YEARS$
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Settle demobilized veterans on a border or outer location for 5 years.
oe_mer2_settle_border_veterans = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_owned_location = {
				is_border = yes
				is_capital = no
			}
		}
		random_owned_location = {
			limit = {
				is_border = yes
				is_capital = no
			}
			add_location_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_mer2_veteran_settlement_loc
				years = 5
				mode = replace
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { any_owned_location = { is_capital = no } }
		random_owned_location = {
			limit = { is_capital = no }
			add_location_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_mer2_veteran_settlement_loc
				years = 5
				mode = replace
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = capital }
		capital = {
			add_location_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_mer2_veteran_settlement_loc
				years = 5
				mode = replace
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Pick a vulnerable location and create an explicit rebel faction bound to 501_oe_mer2_rebel_demands.
oe_mer2_spawn_mutineer_rebels = {
	if = {
		limit = { any_owned_location = { is_capital = no } }
		random_owned_location = {
			limit = { is_capital = no }
			save_scope_as = oe_mer2_target_loc
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = capital }
		capital = { save_scope_as = oe_mer2_target_loc }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate }
		create_rebel = {
			category = estate
			estate = nobles_estate
			name = oe_mer2_free_company_mutineers
			rebel_demand = oe_mer2_rd_free_company_ransom
			save_scope_as = oe_mer2_mutineer_rebels
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:burghers_estate }
		create_rebel = {
			category = estate
			estate = burghers_estate
			name = oe_mer2_free_company_mutineers
			rebel_demand = oe_mer2_rd_free_company_ransom
			save_scope_as = oe_mer2_mutineer_rebels
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:peasants_estate }
		create_rebel = {
			category = estate
			estate = peasants_estate
			name = oe_mer2_free_company_mutineers
			rebel_demand = oe_mer2_rd_free_company_ransom
			save_scope_as = oe_mer2_mutineer_rebels
		}
	}
	else = {
		create_rebel = {
			category = pretender
			name = oe_mer2_free_company_mutineers
			rebel_demand = oe_mer2_rd_free_company_ransom
			save_scope_as = oe_mer2_mutineer_rebels
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Rally disaffected pops in scope:oe_mer2_target_loc to scope:oe_mer2_mutineer_rebels (explicit host scope).
oe_mer2_rally_mutineer_loc = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = oe_mer2_host
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:oe_mer2_target_loc
			exists = scope:oe_mer2_mutineer_rebels
		}
		scope:oe_mer2_target_loc = {
			every_pop = {
				limit = {
					owner = scope:oe_mer2_host
				}
				add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_severe_penalty
				change_pop_allegiance = scope:oe_mer2_mutineer_rebels
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. O(1) yearly arrears risk decay/accumulation pulse.
oe_mer2_yearly_arrears_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				is_during_bankruptcy = yes
				num_loans >= 2
				gold < 0
				monthly_balance < 0
			}
			OR = {
				any_hired_mercenary = { count >= 2 }
				oe_mer2_has_any_charter = yes
			}
		}
		oe_mer2_add_arrears_risk = { AMOUNT = 8 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			any_hired_mercenary = { count >= 3 }
		}
		oe_mer2_add_arrears_risk = { AMOUNT = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = oe_mer2_arrears_risk
			NOT = { any_hired_mercenary = { count >= 1 } }
			NOT = { has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_mer2_free_company_mutiny }
			is_during_bankruptcy = no
			gold >= 0
		}
		oe_mer2_add_arrears_risk = { AMOUNT = -5 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = oe_mer2_arrears_risk
				var:oe_mer2_arrears_risk <= 0
			}
			remove_variable = oe_mer2_arrears_risk
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Clean Dev Panel Page 75 helper: raises arrears risk to 50 and previews oe_mer2.1.
oe_mer2_dev_risk_50 = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_rebel_country = no }
		set_variable = { name = oe_mer2_arrears_risk value = 50 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_mer2_mutiny_cooldown }
			remove_variable = oe_mer2_mutiny_cooldown
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mer2.1
	}
}
